Bill Steer

Real/full name:
William Geoffrey Steer
Age:
56 (born Dec 3rd, 1969)
Place of birth:
United Kingdom (Stockton-on-Tees, Durham, England)
Gender:
Male

Trivia

In 1999, Steer founded the blues rock band Firebird in which he sang and played guitar. They released six albums, and at times also featured Leo Smee and Ludwig Witt. Firebird split-up in 2011.

Together with Carcass bandmate Jeff Walker, Steer founded and ran Necrosis Records. Steer also played on Jeff Walker Und Die Fluffers' album "Welcome to Carcass Cuntry" (2006).
